prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. First image is the edit target. Reframe 25 percent wider so complete focal tree, canopy when present, bench and people all have at least 12 percent empty background inside every edge. Correct the SAME southwest young tree to small slender sapling with crown about half the width of the bench, total height no more than the six-year-old children, fully in frame; NEVER a mature cropped tree. Preserve fixed bench west/left, doorway east/right, clear route, one bench only, and exact action. 
CURRENT SCENE CONTRACT:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Cooler Courtyard; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: An illustrative school courtyard over several days at morning and lunchtime. Locked Kit and Zoe retain designs. One unnamed caretaker: deep-brown skin, bald head, round glasses, gray shirt and navy pants, about 1.7 times child height. Fixed layout: a wall runs along the east side with an open doorway near its north end; a broad route leads from that doorway across the courtyard; bench area west, young tree southwest. Morning sun from the east casts the wall's shadow westward into the courtyard. By midday the proposed morning sitting spot is sunny. No claim to a real measured site.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One plain wooden bench on west side, short new tree with small leafy crown southwest; Open doorway near north end of eastern wall and broad clear route across courtyard; Small clipboard with an unlabelled courtyard sketch; Later one properly installed pale-green shade canopy supported by four posts outside walking route
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 1. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): At lunchtime, the courtyard bench stands in the sun. Kit and Zoe want a cooler place where their class can sit.
Required illustration: Midday sunlit bench with small tree shadow falling away from it; children and caretaker examine the space.
Exact current state: No child touches overheated surfaces; existing courtyard only, no canopy.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
